scope: VB HScrollBar/VScrollBar public range and visibility boundary.
actual_source_basis: The admitted VB5/VB6 XP Styles forms contain both HScrollBar and VScrollBar.
ImageProcessor dynamically changes the visible state and Max of horizontal and vertical scrollbars.
renderer_boundary: Exact ThunderRT5/6 H/VScrollBar maps to the existing SCROLLBAR renderer. Existing public SIF_RANGE/SIF_PAGE/SIF_POS handling and native scroll notifications remain the sole data/input contract.
existing_witness: S6 records actual End/Home and range behavior, while win16_style_scroll_api exercises long range, external SetScrollInfo and list/Combo cases. No product source change is needed.
not_covered: A runnable real VB sample varying every range/page state.
Physical pointer drag on the current desktop.
